reviewers.question: Is the repaired representation scientifically meaningful?
positives: EEP uses trace length and line sequence — genuine structural features
Output-free guarantee is formally defined and testable
Relative line offsets for position invariance is principled
concerns: N=40 is small; target was N≥50 (missed)
Detection rate 63% — still misses 37% of bugs
All programs are synthetic algorithmic programs; no real production code
Line sequence hash loses information about WHICH values flow through paths

reviewers.question: Is the evaluation sufficiently large, fair, and statistically defensible?
positives: Failure-class analysis provided; class-level improvements documented
concerns: Statistical significance NOT achieved: p=0.162 (N too small)
Dev/test split uses SAME corpus (N=40) — overfitting risk unquantifiable
CIs are wide due to only N=2 negative pairs

reviewers.question: Does SBG actually outperform or add information beyond simple features?
positives: Ablation confirms new components drive improvement (C=B=0.829)
concerns: Line sequence divergence may overfit to specific input set
Only N=2 negative pairs for AUROC — statistical reliability extremely low

reviewers.question: Is there any hidden output leakage?
positives: Relative line numbers prevent implicit output encoding
Sequential drift detects state without reading values
Formal output-free theorem stated and tested
concerns: Line sequence captures which BRANCHES are taken; if a value influences a branch, that's indirect output observation — acceptable but worth noting

reviewers.question: Would this be a serious research contribution?
positives: Principled repair addresses a diagnosed root cause
63.2% detection rate is meaningful improvement over 10.5% baseline
Negative results on limits clearly documented (pure-value mutations)
concerns: N=38 bugs is still too small for strong claims; BugsInPy remains blocked
All programs synthetic — real-world validity unverified
Line-sequence divergence could be a weak proxy for output comparison
